[LSER.13.10] **Block-option values are typed by the grammar.** `by:` takes a
slot name or `none` ([LSER.7.6.2]), `capacity:` takes an integer literal
([LSER.13.14]), and `nulls:` takes `skip`, `hold` or `zero` ([LNUL.8.6]).

Each is fixed in its own production, so a value of the wrong kind does not
parse. The one value-level check left is `capacity:`'s lower bound, which
[LSER.13.14] states.
